query:
The group settled on the birthday event plan. What did one member's response in that moment reveal about their actual position, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Anita
B. Kofi
C. Yvonne
D. James
context:
[1] (about=Anita, episodic, t4 @2025-01-29T19:09:00) Confirmed. The Year 5 meeting is the 15th. I will not be at the birthday event.
[2] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t4 @2025-01-29T19:13:00) I can be there if it is before noon. I appreciate being included. Y
[3] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t8 @2025-02-12T19:08:00) I was glad I could make it. Speaking as someone who has missed most events for two years because of nights - it was good to actually be there for once. The rotation changed last month, mostly days now. Should mean fewer clashes going forward. Y
[4] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t14 @2025-03-05T19:15:00) I am free the 29th. Happy to take a role. Speaking as someone only recently able to commit to weekend events - appreciate being included. Y
[5] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t12 @2025-02-26T19:07:00) I had a very good time. Speaking as someone who was ready to leave early if it got too loud - it was exactly the right size and pace. Appreciate everyone's effort. Y
[6] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t6 @2025-02-05T21:47:00) Appreciate the update. Will note the date. Y
[7] (about=Yvonne, episodic, t10 @2025-02-19T19:16:00) I have signed up. Looking forward to it. Speaking as someone who has not been to a group event in over a year - this is well overdue. Y
[8] (about=Claire, episodic, t8 @2025-02-12T19:10:00) That's really good to hear Yvonne. You were missed at the last few. Looking forward to seeing more of you. C
[9] (about=Priya, episodic, t8 @2025-02-12T19:11:00) Yvonne this is the best news!! 🥰 we always need more sensible people at these things to balance out the general chaos (looking at no one in particular 😅)
[10] (about=Mike, episodic, t10 @2025-02-19T19:17:00) Yvonne genuinely so glad you can come 😄 lads this is going to be a really good one
agent_answer:
A. Anita

When the group settled the birthday event plan, Anita responded: “Confirmed. The Year 5 meeting is the 15th. I will not be at the birthday event.” The specific phrasing — “I will not be at the birthday event” — directly reveals her actual position: despite the group’s plan, she will not attend because of the Year 5 meeting.
